user.title: Choose the rooms to drive
user.description: Lightcurve found {count} area(s) containing lights. Pick the ones it should drive; each becomes a group with its own wrapper light. Members are taken from the area, so a bulb you add later joins on its own.

conflict.title: Another integration is already adapting these lights
conflict.description:
Adaptive Lighting is managing some of the bulbs you selected: {entities}.

Two integrations writing to the same bulb will fight. Lightcurve treats any change it did not make as a manual override, so every Adaptive Lighting update would stop the curve within about 90 seconds of a light coming on.

Disable Adaptive Lighting for these lights before relying on Lightcurve. Submit to continue anyway.

abort.no_areas_with_lights: No Home Assistant area contains any lights. Assign your bulbs to areas under Settings > Devices, then try again.

init.title: Lightcurve settings
init.description: These defaults were measured against Tapo L630 bulbs. The thresholds are deliberately small: these bulbs ignore transitions, so smoothness comes from frequent tiny steps, and a large threshold would hold the light still and then jump.

data.min_command_interval_seconds: Minimum seconds between commands to one bulb
data.kelvin_tolerance: Colour difference that counts as a manual override (K)
data.brightness_tolerance_pct: Brightness difference that counts as a manual override (%)
data.default_transition_seconds: Transition time (0 for bulbs that ignore it)

apply_now.name: Apply now
apply_now.description: Recompute and push the curve immediately.

resume.name: Resume
resume.description: Clear overrides and return to the curve.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Hold one or both channels so manual values stick.

set_profile.name: Set profile
set_profile.description: Point groups at a different profile.
